visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera shakes as it moves through a modern living room with light wood floors. A young boy in a black Mickey Mouse t-shirt enters from a doorway, looking curious. Text overlays "POV: There is a big cockroach at home" in Traditional Chinese. The setting is bright with indoor lights. (2) A woman with pinkish-red hair, wearing a white tank top and black athletic shorts, is perched high up on a mezzanine staircase behind a glass railing. She looks down into the room, seemingly on edge. Laundry and clothing hang on a rack directly below her. (3) Back in the living room area, the boy sits on a beige chair holding a toddler girl in his lap. A white Labrador stands nearby with a blue harness. The girl looks distressed with a pouting expression. The camera person's hand is seen pointing toward them. Large colorful Lego-style portraits of Iron Man are visible on the wall in the background. (4) A close-up shot shows the toddler girl with a fearful expression, crying as she is being held. The lighting remains bright and flat, typical of a home interior. She wears a red and black Minnie Mouse themed dress. (5) The woman on the stairs is now holding a green and black aerosol insecticide spray can. She gestures dramatically while talking to the camera, her facial expressions showing intense disgust. Text saying "So disgusting" repeatedly floats across the screen in various fonts. (6) The camera pans down to show a white cylindrical air purifier sitting on the floor in a playroom area. Its digital display lights up with green indicators as the numbers increase rapidly, suggesting it has sensed the spray particles. (7) The final scene shows the white Labrador in a hallway, wagging its tail and looking directly at the camera lens. The dog appears energetic. Comedic text bubbles appear near the dog's head as if it is participating in the conversation.
